summary: L-4 cab on Nannie Ridge, built 1934 and gone by the 1960s; sources describe only foundations and debris, reached by a 3-mile trail in Goat Rocks Wilderness.

facts.status_note: Cab removed or burned in the 1960s; the sources describe foundations and debris, not a standing structure

access.note: Reached on foot by Nannie Ridge Trail 98 in the Goat Rocks Wilderness; the sources describe no closure

visit.trail_note: About 3 miles and roughly 2,100 feet of climbing on Trail 98 from the Walupt Lake area; the old lookout trail turns left at the ridge crossing

events.note: L-4 cab. Register and firelookout.com say 1934; Willhite says 1933-34 and notes the crew was snowed in
Panoramic images taken from the site at 16 feet above the ground
Willhite gives the 1940s only as a decade
Cab removed or burned in the 1960s (decade only; Willhite does not say which). Register says gone by the 1960s; Forest Lookouts lists removed

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register and firelookout.com give 1934; Willhite gives 1933-34. The story reports both dates.
Register and firelookout.com say gone by the 1960s; Willhite says removed or burned in the 1960s. Story says removed or burned, and does not pick one.

notes_for_editor: Gone site with a single cab. Built year differs by a year between sources (1933-34 vs 1934). The 1960s fate is a decade-only claim with removed-or-burned left open. No staffing or fire history is in the sources read, so none is stated. Brief's access 'unknown' is replaced by public (hike on Forest Service trail, no closure described). Used 1 web search and 5 page reads; the WTA trip report is the only source for the current debris.
